title: Man accused of murdering OPP officer dies in hospital
subtitle: Fred Preston, the man charged with killing OPP Const. Vu Pham, has died in hospital, the province's special investigations unit has confirmed. Preston died Thursday night after his daughters decided to take him off life support, according to Alex, Preston's brother.
article: Fred Preston, the man charged with killing an OPP officer, has died in hospital, the province's special investigations unit has confirmed.
Preston passed away on Thursday night after his daughters decided to take him off life support, according to Alex, Preston's brother.

Fred Preston, 70, had been in London's Victoria Hospital since Monday, when a gunfire exchange near Winthrop left him in a coma and an OPP officer dead. On Wednesday, Preston was charged with first-degree murder in the death of Const. Vu Pham, as well as attempted murder in relation to a second officer.
Family say Preston was shot at least four times in the altercation, with one bullet lodging in his brain.
For Alex Preston, the news of his brother's passing brings bitter comfort to the family, which has been devastated by these recent events.
"It's a sad thing to say but he's better off now than if he had to face all this stuff," he said.
"This is kind of what we were hoping for, you know?" he added. "He's better off than if he was a vegetable with that bullet in his brain. He was never going to be right."
Alex said he learned of his brother's death at around 6 p.m. Thursday, when one of Preston's daughters called to inform him they were taking him off life support. He died shortly after.
The news of Pham's death came as a shock to the people of Sundridge, where Pham once lived and Preston served as town reeve in nearby Joly Township.
Preston has been described by friends and family as a friendly, well-liked former logger, an affable father of three who enjoyed hunting and carving wood sculptures.
According to relatives, he and his wife Barbara had been experiencing marital problems, however, and Preston had been upset recently over learning of her extramarital relationships.
Barbara has a sister who lives in the London area and according to some news reports, Preston had gone there on Monday in order to find his wife.
Pham was shot after pulling Preston over on a road just outside of Winthrop.
No information is available yet on whether any funeral arrangements have been made for Preston.
Pham, who leaves behind a wife and three young sons, will be laid to rest on Friday at the North Huron Wescast Community Complex in Wingham.
